text: Editorâ€™s Foreword ix Sometimes a relatively small, determined group of people can have a disproportionately large impact on history, altering the course of whole countries and in certain ways the world.
text_raw:
Editorâ€™s Foreword
ix
Sometimes a relatively small, determined group of people can have a
disproportionately large impact on history, altering the course of whole
countries and in certain ways the world.

text: The Puritans are among such groups, changing not only the religious practices of 16th- and 17th- century England, Scotland, and other areas, but carrying their ways to what became the United States, where the influence was initially rather notable.
text_raw:
The Puritans are among such
groups, changing not only the religious practices of 16th- and 17th-
century England, Scotland, and other areas, but carrying their ways to
what became the United States, where the influence was initially rather
notable.

text: Although there are no longer any Puritans, in the original sense, their trace can be found in the Reformed or Calvinist churches, from which they sprang, and the Congregationalist, Presbyterian, and Baptist churches that succeeded them.
text_raw:
Although there are no longer any Puritans, in the original sense,
their trace can be found in the Reformed or Calvinist churches, from
which they sprang, and the Congregationalist, Presbyterian, and Baptist
churches that succeeded them.

text: More broadly, although there are no Pu- ritans, the concept of puritanism is still used today very widely, if also very inaccurately.
text_raw:
More broadly, although there are no Pu-
ritans, the concept of puritanism is still used today very widely, if also
very inaccurately.

text: The complicated situation in which the Puritans arose, their trajectory across history, and their legacies are more than adequate reasons to justify a Historical Dictionary of the Puritans , but it is the lasting confusion that makes it that much more valuable.
text_raw:
The complicated situation in which the Puritans
arose, their trajectory across history, and their legacies are more than
adequate reasons to justify a Historical Dictionary of the Puritans , but
it is the lasting confusion that makes it that much more valuable.

text: This latest volume in the series on religions, philosophies, and move- ments, and the different ways in which the Puritans can fit into all these categories, is a good way of learning about them.
text_raw:
This latest volume in the series on religions, philosophies, and move-
ments, and the different ways in which the Puritans can fit into all these
categories, is a good way of learning about them.

text: The introduction places them in the context of the times, and helps to define them, an ar- duous task, indeed.
text_raw:

places them in the context of the times, and helps to define them, an ar-

text: This done, details are provided in several hundred entries that focus on crucial figures, most of them (but not all) Puritans, as well as the practices and concepts that defined them.

text: Others describe major events, some of momentous consequence, such as the English Civil Wars and Restoration, and the crossing of the Pilgrim fathers in the Mayflower and establishment of the early colonies in New England.

text: Preface xi Our goal in composing this book has been to fill a void in the existing literature of Puritanism: an extensive, accessible dictionary of the ma- jor persons, terms, and events of the historical Puritan movement.
text_raw:
Preface
xi
Our goal in composing this book has been to fill a void in the existing
literature of Puritanism: an extensive, accessible dictionary of the ma-
jor persons, terms, and events of the historical Puritan movement.

text: The existing compendia of Puritanism usually compose multiple volumes, tend not to justify as we have sought to do in our Introduction their choice of entries, do not encompass both England and America or both older Puritans and later Nonconformists, and are often out of print.
text_raw:
The
